reason: By design: renew charges only a holder who set an order and approved the renewer, at most the order's premium cap, once per opening, for a quote the quoter signed for this contract with strikes near the order's levels; the NFT goes to the holder. Checked by test/RenewerInvariant.t.sol.
Only the answer and its time are used: the answer must be positive and at most MAX_PRICE_AGE old. The round ids don't matter for checking where the strikes sit.
